Title: Expedition combat and co-op polish
Changes: City hooks acquire rooftops, moving giants and boundary walls, with visible launches, sound and hold-or-toggle controls.
Jump or dash while attached to boost; Vesper now fights with twin swords and Nori uses a recoiling underwater shotgun.
Underwater dash now steers and slows smoothly. New sea creatures, clearer cave wayfinding and a more detailed wreck improve Reef exploration.
Gather crystals, plants and mushrooms across every map. XP and gold use new shared pickup models everywhere.
Co-op enemies pursue the nearest living player and spawn around the team. Tab shows damage, DPS, healing, kills and downs.
Both co-op upgrade layouts keep movement active. Rest-room messages no longer block upgrades, and combat effects stop during rest.
Added staged loading, skippable and replayable traversal practice, clearer objectives, smooth enemy-health tracking and a new original menu waltz.
Classic Play starts in Thornmeadow. Reef expeditions continue through Saltglass Shallows and Stormwatch Harbour in that order.
